summary: Comprehensive UI rebuild verification for MindTrace AI. Landing, Dashboard, Insights, History, Explainability, Profile, Settings, About pages all render, no console errors, no NaN/undefined leaked. Navbar (sticky/mobile/profile menu), landing testids, 8-step assessment wizard with all 8 step-rail testids, populate-demo, save-draft, run-multimodal-assessment-button all correct. Backend POST /api/assessments/analyze returns valid 200 with correct fields (Moderate Stress @70.48%). Insights page has 16 confusion-cell testids summing to exactly 400. Settings save persists (navbar+dropdown reflect new name). Field validation on Review page correctly triggers review-validation-error when depression_score=999. CRITICAL BLOCKER FOUND: After clicking 'Analyze My Assessment', analysis-transition shows for ~2s and URL updates to /results, but the Results <main> never mounts. Instead the previous Assessment <main> stays in the DOM with inline style 'opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px);' (its exit state) and never gets removed — the user sees a completely blank page (only navbar+footer) even after 15s. AnimatePresence in App.js appears to deadlock when swapping /assessment -> /results (assessmentMain=True resultsMain=False persists indefinitely). A hard reload of /results renders the report correctly with results-status, result-confidence-score, probability bars, all severity + modality cards. So the data flow is fine — the bug is 100% in the route transition. Mobile 390px shows 4px overflow on / (landing) and 100px overflow on /insights.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: After run-multimodal-assessment-button, navigate('/results') never actually mounts the Results page. The outgoing Assessment PageTransition <main> stays in the DOM stuck at opacity:0 / translateY(-8px) (Framer Motion exit state) and Results <main> is never mounted. URL updates to /results but the viewport is blank between navbar and footer. Reloading /results renders correctly, confirming data + Results component are fine — the AnimatePresence 'wait' swap is deadlocked. Likely cause: both AnalysisTransition (its own AnimatePresence) and PageTransition are exiting in the same render tick, and mode='wait' at the outer AnimatePresence never receives an onExitComplete for Assessment. Consider removing mode='wait' or making Assessment return only a single motion child that owns exit, or delay navigate() until AnalysisTransition finished exiting.
Spec asked for data-testid 'recent-assessments' but the code uses 'recent-assessments-section'. Minor naming mismatch.

integration_issues.issue: Users never see their result unless they manually refresh /results. This effectively breaks the entire assessment flow end-to-end.

issues: Horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=394 vs clientWidth=390 (4px). Likely the SignalNetwork hero or an absolutely positioned label sticking out; add overflow-x:clip on the hero section or clamp its width.

Significant horizontal overflow: scrollWidth=490 vs clientWidth=390 (~100px). Likely the confusion matrix or the model-comparison table row doesn't wrap/scroll internally. Wrap the wide tables/matrix in an overflow-x:auto container at <=640px.

action_items: URGENT: Fix the /assessment -> /results transition deadlock. Recommended fixes to try in order: (a) drop mode='wait' from the AnimatePresence in App.js (transition will crossfade instead of wait), (b) in Assessment.submit(), await a short RAF/timeout after setAnalyzing(false) before calling navigate('/results') so AnalysisTransition's AnimatePresence can finish exit before route unmounts, or (c) hoist AnalysisTransition out of the Assessment page (e.g. render it inside App.js next to Toaster and drive it from the store) so the exiting Assessment page contains only the PageTransition motion.main.
Rename Dashboard testid from 'recent-assessments-section' to 'recent-assessments' to match spec (or accept the '-section' suffix and update spec).
Fix mobile horizontal overflow on / (4px) and /insights (100px). Add overflow-x:clip on the hero and overflow-x:auto on the confusion-matrix/model-comparison containers below 640px.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js AnimatePresence uses mode='wait' but Routes render arbitrary components; if any Route component nests its own AnimatePresence (Assessment does via AnalysisTransition) the parent may deadlock waiting for exit completion. Either lift overlays like AnalysisTransition into App shell or drop mode='wait'.

Assessment.submit() sets analyzing=false in the same tick as navigate('/results'); AnalysisTransition begins its overlay exit at the same moment the Assessment page begins its own PageTransition exit — race condition confirmed in browser.
Results.js correctly handles empty state and loading state; no changes needed there.
Settings.js form uses onSubmit and only fires validation on submit (button type=submit) — works as intended; ensure the submit path is always used (currently correct).

success_rate.frontend: 70% — most pages/data flow are correct; assessment→results transition is a hard blocker for the main user journey.

seed_data_creation: One live assessment posted to /api/assessments/analyze during testing (id 73e64353...). Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reproduce the blank Results bug by: goto /assessment -> click populate-demo-data -> click assessment-step-8-button -> click run-multimodal-assessment-button -> wait 10s. URL becomes /results but querying [data-testid='results-page'] returns null while [data-testid='assessment-page'] persists with inline style opacity:0. Immediately reload /results and the page renders fine (results-status='Moderate Stress', confidence 70%, 4 probability bars, severity + modality cards all populated). Insights, History, Explainability, Dashboard, Profile, Settings, About all render and pass basic testid checks. Confusion matrix cells sum to 400. Mobile overflow: / and /insights at 390px.
rca of the issue: AnimatePresence mode='wait' in App.js delegates exit to child route components. The /assessment route renders <><AnalysisTransition/><PageTransition/></>. In the same render tick where submit() completes, React batches setAnalyzing(false) + navigate('/results'). This starts (1) the AnalysisTransition inner AnimatePresence exit AND (2) the Assessment PageTransition motion.main exit. The outer AnimatePresence never receives an onExitComplete for the whole Assessment subtree (likely because the inner AnimatePresence unmounts before firing its own exit callback, or the two exits compete for exit ordering), so Results is never mounted. Fix options: hoist AnalysisTransition out of the Assessment page (render it globally from store), OR drop mode='wait' on the App-level AnimatePresence, OR defer navigate() by one animation frame after AnalysisTransition finishes exiting.
